items.alt: An Indian boxer raises an Asian Games gold medal and birthday cake while an Indian hockey player scores in the background.
A Real Madrid player pushes a towering dossier into a football governing body's offices while investigators examine documents inside.
A Portugal captain caricature leaves a training camp with a suitcase as teammates continue training behind him.
A giant official hand stamps voter-list papers inside a civic office while protesters face police barricades outside.
A Red Bull-style Formula 1 car leads a Mercedes-style car through a tyre-shredding tropical circuit corner.
